thread:
elena: Heads-up — Legal asked for a compact export showing "who changed routing policies" (who, when, what changed, tenant). We need a proposal for API + console flow. Thoughts?

mike: +1. requirements? export format (ndjson vs csv), redaction, auth. Legal wants provable trail enough for e-discovery.

elena: priority: accuracy + tamper-evidence. Bonus: be able to tie to rollout/canary id. Must avoid leaking creds or ephemeral tokens.

raj: I think NDJSON of change events is the safest: one event per line, include: actor_id, actor_hint (optional), action, resource, timestamp, before/after (compact diff), request_id, trace_id, rollout_id (if present). Example line: `{"actor_id":"u_123","action":"update","resource":"route:r-9","timestamp":"2025-11-02T15:22:01Z","diff":{"old":"/v1/*","new":"/v2/*"}}`

jess: Agree on NDJSON. Ops question: who can trigger exports? We need entitlement + audit-export-quota. Exports are heavy — could be charged or throttled. Also add a retention param for pre-signed link TTL.

elena: entitlement gating is required. UX: console -> Export audit -> choose timeframe + tenant(s) + sampling (full vs sampling) + pseudonymize actors toggle.

mike: Important: pseudonymize should replace actor_id with stable pseudonym (for legal: consistent mapping per export) and include a signed manifest that allows site-admin to map back (kept in KMS). Avoid exposing email by default.

raj: on sampling: must be opt-in. For compliance/legal, we default to full. For big windows, we offer chunked export jobs with cursors. Also provide `cursor` and `chunk_number` in payloads.

tariq: telemetry linkages: include trace_id and route_eval_id so console can show the exact request path. Also add `policy_version` and `cluster_id` for dedicated/private deployments.

jess: API shape idea: POST /audit/exports { "tenant_ids": [...], "from":"..","to":"..","pseudonymize":"true|false","sampling":"none|partial","format":"ndjson","notify":"email@" } -> 202 { "job_id":"...","estimated_size_bytes":"..." }

mike: and GET /audit/exports/:job_id returns status + presigned_url when ready. Presigned URL TTL default 7 days, configurable via enterprise policy.

elena: UX: show preview counts in console (events, unique actors, size estimate) before you confirm — helps quota decisions. Also show a small example row (sanitized).

raj: redaction modes: `none`, `mask_pii` (email -> e***@***), `remove_sensitive` (strip fields defined in schema). Provide server-side rules for claim resolution: e.g., if field path matches `request.headers.authorization` drop.

jess: quota enforcement: per-org monthly export bytes + concurrent export cap (default 2). Deny or queue otherwise. Also admins can request bypass with support ticket.

mike: tamper-evidence: sign bundles with export signing key (ed25519) using job metadata. Include `export_manifest.json` inside bundle with signature + S3 object checksum.

elena: legal wants ability to prove actor identity mapping at time-of-change. That implies we should record `actor_resolution_snapshot` in the export for each unique actor (if not pseudonymized) — e.g., a small map actor_id -> {display_name, email_hash, resolved_at}. Store email_hash not raw email.

raj: note: storing resolution snapshots increases size. Make it optional: `include_actor_snapshot:true|false`. If true, snapshot included as separate NDJSON file inside zip.

audit-bot: Export job 5234567890-1 queued by elena (size_est 24MB). ETA ~45s.

elena: ok next steps: brief doc for API (POST/GET) + console mockup for preview + quota hooks + manifest signing. I'll draft PR. Assign owners?

mike: i'll take API + signing. raj takes export worker + ndjson chunking. jess owns quotas/entitlements UI. tariq will wire telemetry IDs.

elena: thanks. I'll open a planning doc and link to it here: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-export-proposal (placeholder). :+1:

mike: quick note: ensure export endpoints are rate-limited by org ID and require admin role. Also include `requested_by` in the manifest.

jess: and add retention policy checks (if tenant retention < requested window, warn and require justification).

elena: sweet. I'll circle back after the PRs. If anyone has objections to the pseudonymize approach speak up now.

raj: no objections. Small ask: add `preview_sample_size` param for console preview (default 5).

mike: agreed.

elena: closing thread — thanks all.
